Definition: a Gederathite, or inhabitant of Gederah
BiblicalUsage: Gᵉdêrâthîy means a Gederathite, an inhabitant of Gederah. It occurs just once, in 1 Chronicles 12:4, where Josabad the Gederathite stands among the men who came to David at Ziklag.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the Gederathite as he stands — one name among David’s helpers — and I do not make more of him than the verse does.
